records.title: New Parliament Building
records.arknoz_overview: India's New Parliament Building is a major institutional project in New Delhi created for parliamentary functions within the Central Vista precinct. Arknoz should treat it as a working public-building precedent: programme, movement, security, ceremonial requirements, spatial organisation and project delivery should be made legible through verified facts. The record should avoid political commentary and promotional language and instead help students and professionals understand the building as a complex piece of civic architecture.
records.why_it_matters: Useful for institutional planning, public-building design and large-project delivery.

records.title: Royal Opera House Mumbai — Restoration & Adaptive Reuse
records.arknoz_overview: The Royal Opera House Mumbai is a useful Indian precedent for heritage restoration combined with contemporary reuse. Rather than preserving the building as a static monument, the restoration returned it to active cultural use while upgrading performance, acoustic, environmental and safety systems. Arknoz should focus on the relationship between conservation, modern building services and renewed public use: what was retained, what required intervention and how an early twentieth-century performance building was adapted for present-day operation. This makes the record relevant to students and professionals studying conservation, adaptive reuse, interiors, building services and heritage-led regeneration.
records.why_it_matters: A strong precedent showing how significant heritage architecture can be conserved while being returned to active contemporary use.

records.title: GIFT City
records.arknoz_overview: GIFT City is a planned finance and technology district in Gujarat where business space, utilities and urban infrastructure are conceived as an integrated system. Arknoz should focus on the city-scale layers that distinguish it from an individual project: land use, district cooling, utility tunnels, automated waste systems, mobility and public realm. This makes the record useful for understanding how infrastructure and development strategy operate together.
records.why_it_matters: Useful for urban designers, planners, developers and infrastructure professionals studying greenfield city development.
